strata: Source-defined partial highlight; fully clipped distance<=2,2<distance<=8,distance>8 pixels to nonfull support. Pad image with false; exclude outer4 pixels. Threshold minRGB>=254.5/255. No score-dependent selection.
metrics: Equal-image signed-asinh RGB MSE, mean bias and gradient residual MSE with both edge endpoints in same stratum. Not identical to existing log-luminance RMSE acceptance; no threshold changes.
scope: Fixed hash-selected48 TRAIN and complete96 coherent DEV. TRAIN raw predictions only; DEV raw and constrained. Descriptive diagnosis on previously examined data, not independent acceptance.
